parsed.post: Found a significant improvement by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.1019 to 1.0172. I'm moving on to tuning the learning rate and aspect ratio to see if we can squeeze out more performance with this higher capacity model.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 helped significantly; now tuning MATRIX_LR and ASPECT_RATIO to optimize the larger capacity model.
